fix: recover cancellations when preparation is disabled

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-46
  description: |-
    Retain cancellation recovery composition from the configured preparation root even when new execution preparation is disabled, so sealed cleanup handoffs can preserve unique work or open Attention instead of stalling.
    
    Document migration 0132 preservation, immediate owned cleanup, requeue gating, downgrade safety, and the cancellation-policy exception in the picker specification and OpenWiki.
